name: Otoko no Ko☆Revolution ~Ketsu Manko Kyun Kyun☆Otoko no Ko Idol wa, Chinpo Love-Forever♪~
original_name: 男の娘☆れぼりゅ～しょん ～ケツマンコキュンキュン☆ オトコノコアイドルは、チンポLOVE-FOREVER♪～
source:
Otokonoko Revolution is a platinum-selling boys' idol group with three members: Mizuki, Rui and Aria.

These pretty girl-boys love the producer. I mean, really love him. 
After the show they seduce him in the changing room, without ever taking off their outfits!

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE127105.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
Otokonoko Revolution是一个白金销量的男子偶像团体，由三名成员组成：Mizuki、Rui和Aria。

这些漂亮的男孩女孩都很喜欢制片人。我的意思是，真的很爱他。
演出结束后，他们在更衣室里引诱他，连衣服都没脱！

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE127105.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
